title: Third Conditional: More Practice — Quiz 82
content:
## Third Conditional: More Practice

Practise unreal past situations with past perfect and conditional perfect.

### Lesson focus

1. If I ___ harder in my youth, my life would have been comfortable today. (work)
2. The cat ___ got into the kitchen if you had shut the door. (had not / would not have)

### Understand the pattern

Pay attention to the time of the result, not just the heading of the exercise. An unreal past condition can have a present result; that is a mixed conditional. A result about the past uses would have plus a past participle.

### Worked answers and explanation

1. If I had worked harder in my youth, my life would have been comfortable today. The given result form is possible, but for a clearly present result, 'my life would be more comfortable today' is more natural.
2. The cat would not have got into the kitchen if you had shut the door.

The word today reveals the different time relationship in item 1.

### Try another

Complete with a present result: If I had saved the map, I ___ where to go now. (know)

### Suggested answer

Would know. The saving did not happen in the past, but the imagined knowledge concerns now.
